title: Interesting Indicators
description: A simple QoL mod that hides coordinates in F3 and shows coordinates and time only when a compass or clock is in your inventory.
body:
🧭 **Interesting Indicators** is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that changes how players access world information in a more immersive and balanced way.
By default, the mod **hides coordinates from the F3 debug screen**, encouraging exploration without constant positional data. To compensate, coordinates and in-game time are **shown only when the appropriate vanilla items are present** in the player’s inventory.

### ✨ Features
* 🛑 Hides XYZ coordinates from the F3 debug screen
* 🧭 Shows player coordinates when a **compass** is in the inventory
* ⏰ Shows in-game time when a **clock** is in the inventory
* 🎮 Vanilla-friendly and immersion-focused
* ⚙️ Lightweight and compatible with most modpacks

### 🧭 Gameplay Philosophy
This mod keeps navigation and time tracking tied to vanilla items, making exploration feel more natural and rewarding while preserving useful information when it makes sense.
Perfect for survival, hardcore, SMP, and immersion-focused modpacks.
